honesty_note: Every value in this file was produced by running ml/train_model.py on the synthetic dataset. Nothing is hand-written. Re-running with the same seed reproduces these numbers exactly.

metric_meaning.precision: Of the emails predicted PHISHING, the share that really were phishing. Low precision = false alarms = analyst alert fatigue.
metric_meaning.recall: Of the phishing emails present, the share the model caught. Low recall = missed attacks.
metric_meaning.f1: Harmonic mean of precision and recall - one number when both errors matter.
metric_meaning.roc_auc: Probability that a random phishing email is ranked above a random legitimate one. Threshold-independent.
metric_meaning.accuracy: Share of all predictions that were correct. Misleading on imbalanced data and when the two error types have different costs.
